chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Who was on the USO tour; War Bond shows
summary: The unit comprised Spencer, Willie Bryant, Julia Gardner, Betty Logan and Ramirez as sole accompanist, and sold War Bonds across the islands.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Well, who was on this trip with you?
On that trip was Kenneth Spencer, Willie Bryant, Julia Gardner and Betty Logan and myself.
Yeah, it was an Entertainment Unit.
But these people, but with any musicians besides you?
So you just accompanied all of them.

Yeah. And not only that. We did entertainment in public places where they could sell War Bonds. They would buy the Bonds to see us, and after we'd leave they would just give them back! The Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico and all through there, Jamaica... All of them down to South America.
I never knew you went down there.
